2225-2556-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-2556-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1832-5231-6634.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-6634.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

141-6797-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-6797-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-6797-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2730-6553-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

728-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
728-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1170-1976-2921-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-2921-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

413-4186-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.

1870-4873-5087-5159.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor has at least as many charge counters on it as 20 minus your life total.
1870-4873-5087-5159.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield at instant speed.
There is at least one counter of any kind on The Ozolith.
1870-4873-5087-5159.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra and The Ozolith trigger.
Resolve the Mishra trigger, creating an artifact creature token copy of Eternity Vessel that enters with a number of charge counters equal to your life total.
In response to the remaining trigger, cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
Resolve The Ozolith trigger from step 1, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

1308-2557-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-2557-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

511-817-4050-7704-7824.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4770-5789.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-5789.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

475-549-1274-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-1274-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

147-5147-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-5147-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2793-3743-5089-6441-7435.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-6441-7435.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1988-4050-4659-5660-7273.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Unlucky Cabbage Merchant triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Unlucky Cabbage Merchant, adding {G}.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Unlucky Cabbage Merchant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Unlucky Cabbage Merchant ability from step 2, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Cast Unlucky Cabbage Merchant by paying {2}{G}.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant enters, it triggers, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

4050-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Repeat from step 4.

4365-4871-5626.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
4365-4871-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Mondrak.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
4365-4871-5626.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

7-4907-5226-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4907-5226-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-7014-7297.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2292-3678-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2292-3678-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

104-671-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-671-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

640-2173-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

678-4050-4826-6644.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {G}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

575-4674-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-4674-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Temur Charger, adding {R}.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

1753-3259--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1753-3259--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

152-2034-5446-6441.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

222-527-4050-5223.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

147-4499-6001--69.description:
Cast Megaton's Fate by paying {5}{R}, targeting the indestructible artifact.
Holding priority, activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Megaton's Fate, with the copy targeting the indestructible artifact.
Resolve the copy of Megaton's Fate, failing to destroy the artifact due to it being indestructible, and creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 2.

2906-2908-3682-5542.easyPrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
2906-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2092-4687-4949.notablePrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-4687-4949.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1668-4067.description:
Activate Loran of the Third Path by tapping it, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Loran of the Third Path.
Repeat.

1369-3990-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-3990-5137.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental twice by paying {U}{U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Incubation Druid and Morphling until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2174-3078-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3078-3525.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
